reviews.label: Sample review
reviews.name: Karthik
reviews.comment: The Chicken Dum Biryani at ₹180 has great coal-dum flavor and generous portions. Quick counter pickup near the Potheri railway gate.

reviews.label: Sample review
reviews.name: Ananya
reviews.comment: Ordered Paneer Butter Masala, Butter Naan, and Double Ka Meetha on WhatsApp. Neat packing and fresh, balanced spices.

reviews.label: Sample review
reviews.name: Farhan
reviews.comment: Mutton Biryani and Chicken 65 are consistently good. Ordering directly on WhatsApp avoids delivery app markups.
